title: Chat
points: Without an account, chats aren't saved. A chat lasts until you reload or start a new one. A finished answer is held for up to 15 minutes so it can be picked up if your connection drops, then deleted.
With an account, your prompts and answers are saved to your chats until you delete them. Deleting a chat removes its audio and images.
Your messages, voice recordings and photos are used only to answer you. Voice is turned into text and then discarded.
When you ask from the Hypa keyboard, the text in the field you are typing in is sent only to answer and is never stored.
We record how much each request used (model, tool and cost), without your messages, to keep the service running.
